We’ve got some very exciting news for you today, as we reveal the first details of the METRO 2039 Collector’s Edition, available to pre-order later this year.

For the first time in METRO history, the upcoming Collector’s Edition will allow you to become a tangible part of the world with an authentic, beautifully crafted replica of the mysterious Stranger’s battle-scarred helmet.

Each one has its own unique qualities, and the Stranger’s helmet is no different. Through its damage detail, scratches and personal customisations, the Stranger’s helmet tells its own story of a post-apocalyptic life marked by untold horrors, trauma, and life-or-death decisions.
